closed_questions.question: Do the two private command-center repositories duplicate this control plane, and must they be reviewed before building further control-plane surface?
closed_questions.answer: No. Both Khu-el/NTE-Command-Center and Khu-el/StructureGen are archived.
closed_questions.evidence: Stated by the principal 2026-10-05, answering a direct question. An earlier attempt to attach them was refused by the permission classifier, so their contents were never read and remain UNKNOWN - archived means inactive, not reviewed.
closed_questions.effect: Lifts the hold recorded in ADR-0001 conflict 1. The live command center is the in-repo nte-command-center/ project, which is a non-workspace project here rather than a separate surface.
